SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.DOCNUM ,S.SITE ,SI.SITENAM SITEDES ,DOCGRP.OPTDES DOCGRP ,S.DOCTYP ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), S.DOCDAT, 23) DOCDAT ,S.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,S.REMARK ,S.PRJNUM ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTA ,MAX(S.CREUSR) CREUSR ,MAX(S.UPDUSR) UPDUSR ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), MAX(S.CRETIM), 21) CRETIM ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), MAX(S.UPDTIM), 21) UPDTIM FROM PRECLIN S LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON S.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCGRP ON DOCGRP.OPTID = S.DOCGRP AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'PRC' LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN ENTSITE SI ON S.SITE = SI.SITE WHERE S.DOCNUM='{0}' GROUP BY DOCNUM ,S.SITE ,SI.SITENAM ,DOCGRP.OPTDES ,S.DOCTYP ,S.DOCDAT ,S.BPSNO ,BPS.BPSNAM ,S.REMARK ,S.PRJNUM ,DOCSTA.OPTDES
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: MERGE INTO [PRECEIPT] D USING (SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'PRC' DOCTYP ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@BPSNO@' BPSNO ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR ,GETDATE() CRETIM) S ON ( S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM] ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SITE = S.SITE, DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP, DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT, DOCDES = S.DOCDES, REMARK = S.REMARK, CLOREA = S.CLOREA, PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM, BPSNO = S.BPSNO, UPDUSR = '#LOGIN_USER#', UPDTIM = GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM, SITE, DOCGRP, DOCTYP, DOCDAT, DOCDES, REMARK, CLOREA, PRJNUM, BPSNO, DOCSTA, CREUSR, CRETIM ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM, S.SITE, S.DOCGRP, S.DOCTYP, S.DOCDAT, S.DOCDES, S.REMARK, S.CLOREA, S.PRJNUM, S.BPSNO, S.DOCSTA, S.CREUSR, S.CRETIM );
